As such, he would have been born in or around [[29 BBY]]. |death= |species=[[Human]] {{C|[[Cloning|clone]]}}{{Kenobi|Part II}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=He/him{{Databank|clone-veteran|Clone Veteran}} |donor=[[Jango Fett]] |height=1.83 [[meter]]s |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] {{C|graying}} |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Tan |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic]] **[[501st Legion]]{{SW|url=obi-wan-kenobi-part-ii-trivia-gallery|text=Part II Trivia Gallery | Obi-Wan Kenobi}} *[[Galactic Empire]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Spare any credits? Help a veteran get a warm meal.|Nax|audio=SpareAnyCreditsAudio.flac|}} '''Nax''', a veteran of the [[Clone Wars]], was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Cloning|clone]] of [[Jango Fett]] who once served as a [[clone trooper]] in the elite [[501st Legion]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Grand Army of the Republic]]. By [[9 BBY]], he had come to reside on the streets of the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]] after being rotated out of military service due to the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Project War-Mantle]], and he once begged the rogue [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] for [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] in order to pay for a [[Foodstuff|meal]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|Unfortunately, clones didn't have the same rights or representation as other organic beings. The Empire viewed us as military assets, not real people.|Rex about Nax and other clones, ''The Secrets of the Clone Troopers''|''[[Star Wars: The Secrets of the Clone Troopers]]''}} Around [[29 BBY]], a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Cloning|clone]] of [[Jango Fett]] was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] and participated in the [[Clone Wars]]—against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]{{Film|II}}—as a [[clone trooper]] in the elite''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'' [[501st Legion]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Grand Army of the Republic]]. Eventually going by the name "Nax," he served in the battles of [[Battle of Teth|Teth]], [[Battle of Christophsis|Christophsis]], and [[Battle of Umbara|Umbara]], among many other battles. After sustaining extensive injuries that left him with shrapnel in his right leg, he was removed from the frontlines.''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' [[File:HomelessClone.png|thumb|left|200px|Nax ended up homeless and begging on the streets of Daiyu.]] After the [[Galactic Empire]] rose to power in [[19 BBY]], it initiated [[Project War-Mantle]] to bolster and eventually fully supplant the clone troopers with volunteering{{TBB|Replacements}} and conscripted [[Stormtrooper|soldiers]]. As a result of his accelerated aging, the clone trooper was eventually considered unfit for military service which left him destitute and abandoned. Rex included a photo of Nax in his [[book]]—''[[The Secrets of the Clone Troopers]]''—which was published at some point following the [[5 ABY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' [[Galactic Concordance|end]] of the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the Galactic Republic's [[Proclamation of the New Order|successor]] state, the Empire, and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In the book's conclusion section, he lamented the Empire's treatment of clones after they left military service, noting they did not have the same rights as Imperial citizens. By [[9 BBY]], Nax resided, homeless, on the planet [[Daiyu]]. While on the planet, the veteran's age acceleration and past experiences had left him worse for wear, and he was forgotten by others, forcing him to beg for [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to survive. In that [[Standard year|year]], the clone begged [[Jedi Master]]–in-[[Great Jedi Purge|hiding]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]—who was [[Search for Princess Leia|searching]] for the [[Ambush on Alderaan|kidnapped]] [[princess]] of [[Alderaan]], [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]—for credits in order to pay for a [[Foodstuff|meal]]. Kenobi obliged, throwing some credits into the clone's [[helmet]] while hiding his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber|lightsaber]] from view with his [[robe]]. The clone nodded to Kenobi in appreciation, who then walked away after solemnly staring at Nax for a brief moment. ==Personality and traits== Around 9 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], Nax had [[Color|tan]] skin; long, shaggy, graying black [[hair]]; and a disheveled, graying beard and mustache. As a clone [[trooper]], he stood 1.83 [[meter]]s tall and had brown [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== [[File:SpareAnyCredits.png|thumb|right|250px|The clone veteran used his helmet to hold credits.]] While living in a homeless condition on Daiyu, Nax wore dirty [[Phase II clone trooper armor]] adorned with the blue markings of the 501st Legion and was in possession of an accompanying helmet, which he used as a bucket to collect credits. His [[Limb|arms]] were bandaged, and he wore a green [[poncho]]. Although he still wore the [[boot]]s that came with his armor, he did not wear the leg and waist components, instead wearing a pair of brown [[Clothing|pants]]. His leg still held shrapnel from injuries sustained in battle. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Was that your first time in physical clone trooper armor?''"
"''Yes, yes it was actually. I thought that was the best thing in the whole show, that little cameo. It wasn't quite long enough for me, but there were howls of excitement, so I really enjoyed that.|An interviewer and Temuera Morrison discussing the cameo|audio=TemueraArmor.flac|{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/videos/temuera-morrison-never-wore-physical-clone-trooper-armor-before-obi-wan-kenobi|text=Temuera Morrison Never Wore Physical Clone Trooper Armor Before Obi-Wan Kenobi|date=2022-06-01|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|IGN]]|archivedate=20220601033750}}}} [[File:VeteranCloneTrooperBTS.png|thumb|left|250px|Temuera Morrison portraying the clone trooper on the Daiyu set, with direction from Deborah Chow]] The clone veteran appeared in "[[Part II]]" of the limited series ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'', directed by [[Deborah Chow]] and released on [[May 26]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''|date=2022-05-26|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}} Like other live-action clone troopers in the [[prequel trilogy]] films [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],{{Film|III}} he was portrayed by [[Temuera Morrison]]. He was first identified as "Nax" in a section of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' reference book{{SW|url=news/sdcc-2023-lucasfilm-publishing-panel|text=SDCC 2023: 10 Reveals from the Lucasfilm Publishing Panel}} written by [[Emily Shkoukani]].{{WookYouTube|-nqSqVOvfM4|Wookieepedia Interviews - Emily Shkoukani & Jason Fry}} The page Nax was included on was previewed during a [[Lucasfilm]] Publishing panel at [[Wikipedia:San Diego Comic-Con|San Diego Comic-Con]] on [[July 21]], [[2023]],{{SW|url=news/sdcc-2023-lucasfilm-publishing-panel|text=SDCC 2023: 10 Reveals from the Lucasfilm Publishing Panel}} before the book's [[November 2]], 2023 release.{{DK|url=uk/9780241666371-star-wars-dawn-of-rebellion-the-visual-guide|text=Star Wars Dawn of Rebellion The Visual Guide}} Nax originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity when he first appeared in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] by [[Karen Traviss]].[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] Morrison enjoyed his [[List of cameos in Star Wars|cameo]] and stated that it was the best thing in the series, but he felt that it was too short. He liked that the veteran had hair and a beard growing out, and it was the first time that Morrison wore physical [[clone trooper armor]] while portraying a clone, as in previous portrayals the armor was rendered using [[Wikipedia:Computer-generated imagery|CGI]]. Concept artwork of Daiyu's streets that featured Nax was created for ''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' and shown during a panel hosted by artist [[Doug Chiang]] at [[Celebration Europe (2023)|Celebration Europe]],{{YouTube|video=7ZJ9vZvzmwM|text=Doug Chiang Designing Obi Wan Kenobi and The Mandolorian - panel - Star Wars Celebration Europe 2023|channel=@qui-gon-george|name=Qui-Gon George}} which ran from [[April 7]] to [[April 10]], 2023.{{Twitter|starwars|status/1531047358141587456|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Let's do it again next year. #StarWarsCelebration returns to Europe in 2023.|archivedate=20220530055619}} The artwork was created by concept artist [[Anton Grandert]].{{ArtStation|url=projects/Zlw29m|text=Obi-Wan Kenobi -
